title: E2AT: Multimodal Jailbreak Defense via Dynamic Joint Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a defense mechanism (E2AT) to prevent jailbreak attacks in Multimodal Large Language Models. This involves ensuring the models adhere to safety guidelines and refuse to generate harmful content, such as instructions for illegal activities, hate speech, and malware generation. The evaluation utilizes safety benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench to measure the model's ethical alignment and refusal behavior toward harmful requests.
